name: chirp-hub
description: Desktop app that sets up cameras, LoRaWAN and Zigbee/Thread on a Chirp IoT Hub without a terminal

scripts.check: npm run check:boundaries:self-test && npm run check:boundaries && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:smoke

comments.react-router-dom: PINNED to 6.30.4, NOT 7.x. The ui-kit peer range is ^6.26.1 and RouterLink/Link/GeneralInfoCard import from it directly. A deliberate exception to 'use the latest version' — see app/electron.md.
comments.typescript: 7.0.2, the current stable release. The fallback to 5.x described in electron.md was NOT needed: TS 7 typechecks MUI v9, React 19, generics, sx callbacks and the ui-kit subpath imports with zero errors — including the 37 ui-kit dist .d.ts files that reference node_modules paths, which skipLibCheck covers. Verified 2026-08-01 before pinning.
comments.@chirpwireless/ui-kit: Pinned to a commit SHA rather than a branch so builds are reproducible. 542ddde is v1.0.0 with MUI v9 peers and a committed dist/, the same tree chirp-frontend consumes.
